metadata.description: Worker Managed Identity Principal ID: The Object or Principal ID GUID of the Worker Function App System-Assigned Managed Identity to grant Reader access on this subscription.

Worker ArcEvent Function Resource ID: The full Azure Resource ID of the Worker Function App ArcEvent function (/subscriptions/.../providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/worker/functions/ArcEvent) that receives Event Grid events.

Event Grid Subscription Name: Name for the subscription-scoped Event Grid subscription that triggers when entraiddeviceid / entraiddeviceidlinux Guest Configuration assignments or MDE extensions complete.
Scoped Resource Group Names (Optional): Optional list of Resource Group names to filter Event Grid events. Leave empty to monitor all resource groups in this subscription.
